cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.90%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.10%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.61%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +12.20%, PWR +7.29%, EOSE +6.04%, NXT +5.74%, ARRY +5.01%. Laggards: ENPH -16.61%, SEDG -9.70%, BKR -6.51%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.57% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
